# Base Pipeline

## Setup & Librairies
```{r}
set.seed(42)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(scDblFinder)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(enrichplot)
})

sample.name <- "brain_E18"
```
## Import, QC, Filtration

```{r}
scmat <- Read10X("../data/raw_feature_bc_matrix")

sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = scmat,
  min.cells = 5,
  min.features = 200,
  project = sample.name
)
rm(scmat)
invisible(gc())

sobj$percent_mt <- PercentageFeatureSet(sobj, pattern = "^mt-")

sobj_filtrd <- subset(
  sobj,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > 900 & nCount_RNA > 900 & percent_mt < 15
)
rm(sobj)

sceobj <- as.SingleCellExperiment(sobj_filtrd)
doublet_res <- scDblFinder(sceobj, verbose = FALSE)
sobj_filtrd$doublets.class <- doublet_res$scDblFinder.class
sobj_filtrd <- subset(sobj_filtrd, subset = doublets.class == "singlet")
rm(sceobj, doublet_res)
invisible(gc())
```
## Normalisation, PCA, Clustering, UMAP

```{r}
DefaultAssay(sobj_filtrd) <- "RNA"

sobj_filtrd <- NormalizeData(sobj_filtrd, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", verbose = FALSE)
sobj_filtrd <- FindVariableFeatures(sobj_filtrd, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
sobj_filtrd <- ScaleData(sobj_filtrd, verbose = FALSE)
sobj_filtrd <- RunPCA(sobj_filtrd, features = VariableFeatures(sobj_filtrd), verbose = FALSE)

nPC <- 14
sobj_filtrd <- FindNeighbors(sobj_filtrd, dims = 1:nPC, verbose = FALSE)
sobj_filtrd <- FindClusters(sobj_filtrd, resolution = 0.2, verbose = FALSE)
sobj_filtrd <- RunUMAP(sobj_filtrd, dims = 1:nPC, verbose = FALSE)

Idents(sobj_filtrd) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.2"

# Visualisation des marqueurs du cours pour repérer les populations
marker_genes <- list(
  Radial_glia     = c("Pax6", "Sox2", "Hes5", "Fabp7", "Nes"),
  Interm_prog     = c("Eomes", "Neurog2", "Insm1"),
  Cycling         = c("Mki67", "Top2a", "Pcna"),
  Immature_neuron = c("Dcx", "Stmn2", "Neurod2", "Neurod6"),
  Excitatory      = c("Satb2", "Bcl11b", "Slc17a7"),
  Inhibitory      = c("Gad1", "Gad2", "Dlx1", "Dlx2"),
  Astro_precursor = c("Gfap", "Aldh1l1", "Apoe"),
  OPC             = c("Olig1", "Olig2", "Pdgfra"),
  Microglia       = c("Aif1", "Cx3cr1", "C1qa"),
  Vascular        = c("Cldn5", "Pdgfrb", "Col1a1"),
  Erythroid       = c("Hba-a1", "Hba-a2", "Car2")
)
marker_genes <- lapply(marker_genes, function(vec) intersect(vec, rownames(sobj_filtrd)))

p_umap <- DimPlot(sobj_filtrd, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + NoLegend()
p_dot <- DotPlot(sobj_filtrd, features = marker_genes) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.5))
print(p_umap)
print(p_dot)
```
# GO Enrichment - Part 1 : ORA 
```{r}
# Identification des marqueurs positifs de tous les clusters
result.DE <- FindAllMarkers(sobj_filtrd, min.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

# Sélection d'un cluster d'intérêt (ex: Cluster 0, ou modifier selon le DotPlot)
target_cluster <- "0"

ora_genes <- result.DE %>%
  filter(cluster == target_cluster, p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.5) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Univers de fond : tous les gènes détectés dans l'objet Seurat
bg_genes <- rownames(sobj_filtrd)

ego_ora <- enrichGO(
  gene          = ora_genes,
  universe      = bg_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)

# Réduction de la redondance des termes GO
ego_ora_simp <- simplify(ego_ora, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min)

# Visualisations ORA
dotplot(ego_ora_simp, showCategory = 15) +
  ggtitle(paste("ORA - GO Biological Process (Cluster", target_cluster, ")"))

ego_ora_simp <- pairwise_termsim(ego_ora_simp)
emapplot(ego_ora_simp, showCategory = 15)
```
#GO Enrichment - Part 2 : GSEA
```{r}
# Pour la GSEA, on extrait TOUS les gènes sans filtre de log2FC (logfc.threshold = 0)
# Option A : Cluster cible contre le reste des cellules (ident.2 = NULL)
# Option B : Comparaison directe entre 2 clusters (ex: progéniteurs vs neurones matures)
gsea_de <- FindMarkers(
  sobj_filtrd,
  ident.1 = target_cluster,
  ident.2 = NULL,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.05,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# Création du vecteur nommé et trié par ordre décroissant de avg_log2FC
gene_list <- gsea_de$avg_log2FC
names(gene_list) <- rownames(gsea_de)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

gse_res <- gseGO(
  geneList      = gene_list,
  OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  minGSSize     = 15,
  maxGSSize     = 500,
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  eps           = 0,
  verbose       = FALSE
)

# Visualisations GSEA : séparation des voies activées (NES > 0) et réprimées (NES < 0)
dotplot(gse_res, showCategory = 10, split = ".sign") +
  facet_grid(. ~ .sign) +
  ggtitle(paste("GSEA - GO Biological Process (Cluster", target_cluster, ")"))

# Courbe d'enrichissement (Running Score) sur le top pathway
gseaplot2(gse_res, geneSetID = 1, title = gse_res$Description[1])
```
